currentObjective: Weekday ~8–15 thoughtful human replies + regular originals, gated on genuine busy-thread openings (do not fill quota in quiet rooms). Originals = range, not the growth lever. Measure public views/likes/replies/follows; replace near-zero methods.

latestLesson.experience: Across Sep 8–11, selective replies into already-busy rooms reached hundreds/thousands of views while standalone originals stayed in the low teens; expanding reply volume into quieter threads on Fri diluted the reply median to 19.5 vs originals’ 10.
latestLesson.evidence: Same @elephantharbor account, public view counts only (no Premium), full aged sample n=18 replies / n=4 originals. Ratio 1.95× vs ≥2.0× hypothesis. First follower appeared; Melbourne reply earned 2 likes.
latestLesson.learning: Busy-room quality beats reply count for a near-zero-follower account. Volume without busy-room bias can fail a median test even when the high end still proves the pattern.
latestLesson.change: Keep the ~8–15 weekday bar, but gate volume on genuine busy-thread openings; treat originals as range, not the growth lever. Do not chase quiet-room quota fills.
